Maya: Quick shoutout — Devin and Sam rescued the tea pantry chaos and saved the rubber plant this morning. Absolute legends. :tada: :leafy_green:
Devin: not legends, just caffeinated triage. :coffee: Sam actually unplugged the leaky mister and wrestled the plant into the sunny window 😂
Sam: I did the unglamorous work. Plant is upright, soil fluffed, and I restocked Earl Grey (for peak morale). Anyone want me to leave a watering schedule sticky?
Liz (people-ops): Huge thanks everyone! Dropping a tiny treat — sticker for "Plant Guardian" and a coffee voucher for the duo. Also scone poll for tomorrow: :+1: blueberry, :-1: plain, :heart: chocolate chip.
Maya: poll noted. I vote :+1: blueberry. Also tagging #kudos — can we add them to green-team shoutouts? @Liz
OpsBot: Kitchen inventory alert — Earl Grey tea bags: 2 boxes remaining. Auto-reorder set to trigger when stock < 3.
Devin: thanks OpsBot. And thanks team — will accept my sticker with great humility. :blobheart: 
Sam: I will accept the coffee voucher on behalf of the plant. Also open to being co-guardian if someone else wants stake duty. :seedling:
Liz (people-ops): Added them to #kudos and sent voucher codes via DM. Everyone: feel free to nominate next week's plant sitter in thread.
Maya: love this. small wins = big morale. :sparkles:
